findings.function: all functions touching EscrowState.Context (slot 0), StETH/UnstETH accounting totals (slots 1, 2) and WithdrawalsBatchesQueue.QueueInfo (slot 5)
findings.source: EscrowState.Context {State state; Duration minAssetsLockDuration; Duration rageQuitExtensionPeriodDuration; Timestamp rageQuitExtensionPeriodStartedAt; Duration rageQuitEthWithdrawalsDelay}; QueueInfo {State state; ... uint64 totalUnstETHIdsCount; uint64 totalUnstETHIdsClaimed}; StETHAccounting / UnstETHAccounting packed uint128 pairs
findings.issue: Four packed slots stay 'uint256' and every field access is shift/mask arithmetic (234 lines); one write stores the slot's own value back (uint8(x) | 256 * (x / 256) is x), and field updates print -2^128 as a decimal factor and distribute shifts over sums.
findings.rule: Split a slot whose reads are consistently masked/shifted into fields (offsets 0/8/40/72/112, 128/192...); recognise uint8(x) | (x >> 8) << 8 as x (a no-op store); print x * 2^k as x << k and (a << k) + (b << k) as (a + b) << k.

notes: Source loops (11): AssetsAccounting.accountUnstETHLock/Unlock/Finalized/Claimed/Withdraw, WithdrawalsBatchesQueue._getNextClaimableUnstETHIds, addUnstETHIds ('while idx < _28 - 1', assert -> Panic(1)), calcRequestAmounts, and the ABI loops of getLockedUnstETHDetails, lockUnstETH and unlockUnstETH; all shown as while (lockUnstETH 1028/1087/1096, unlockUnstETH 827/936, markUnstETHFinalized 1242, claimUnstETH 745, withdrawETH 476, requestNextWithdrawalsBatch 1514/1580, getNextWithdrawalBatch 624, claimNextWithdrawalsBatch 1328/1703...). Implicit: decoders of returned arrays, encoders, one zero-init (P3), P7 ~12. P11: Panic(50) of ids[i + 1] inside 'while i < count - 1'. 37 ABI functions read; the batch functions by structure.
summary: Every source loop is found and the semantics match, but the dual-governance packed state (escrow state, accounting totals, batch queue info) is never split into fields, so most of the text is shift/mask arithmetic with a no-op store and decimal powers of two.
